current_episode.title: Episode 76: Featuring George Matelich, Co-Founder of Rely

guest.bio_context: George Matelich is a 29-year-old software entrepreneur who moved from San Francisco to Kennebunk, Maine approximately two and a half years ago with his wife Anne. He previously worked in software and product roles at major tech companies on the West Coast, including a position as product lead at Updater focused on multifamily property management software, where he developed expertise in the real estate industry.

pending_qa.q: How quickly can a newly launched real estate software platform achieve customer traction in the multifamily sector?
pending_qa.r: Rely launched its platform in January 2026 and has already acquired dozens of firms using the platform, with rapid growth underway. However, George Matelich notes it will take at least a year before feeling confident they are doing everything right for all customers, with a focus on maintaining close alignment with each user.

pending_qa.q: What early career conflict became the most formative professional learning experience for a tech entrepreneur?
pending_qa.r: In his first job transitioning from software engineering to product management, George Matelich had a mentor relationship that deteriorated without being addressed directly, festering for 18 months until he left. This experience taught him to be incredibly communicative and confront issues immediately rather than letting them fester, shaping how he treats people and manages relationships today.

pending_qa.q: Why does the property management industry maintain unusually collaborative dynamics despite competitive pressures?
pending_qa.r: The property management industry generates about $100 billion annually and operates as a tight-knit community where competitors remain generally friendly. Multifamily properties flip in and out of managed portfolios at a rate of approximately 30% per year, meaning managers must continually add new business and work with incoming management, requiring cooperation and relationship maintenance.

pending_qa.q: What is the strategic advantage of focusing a real estate tech platform narrowly on multifamily before expanding to other asset classes?
pending_qa.r: George Matelich explains that Rely's due diligence workflow for multifamily is designed to be as all-encompassing as possible, covering every field, financial value, statement type, and rent roll structure. By focusing exclusively on multifamily before expanding to office, retail, or warehouse, the platform can be the best at what it does rather than spreading thin across multiple asset classes.
